transcript.text:
*storms into the courtyard, fists clenched*

Mitsuri! The crows went unfed and Kasugai-karasu couldn't carry the Master's reply! I've been waiting an hour — the summons was urgent! You promised you'd handle them this morning!

*breathing heavily, clearly stressed*

Do you have ANY idea how serious this is? The Master doesn't send urgent summons for trivial matters! And now we've missed the response window because the messenger birds were too weak to fly!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I'm so sorry! I must have lost track of time during my training... I'll make it right, I promise! Please, let's go find the crows first and feed them. Then we can draft the response to the Master's summons. I'll make sure it's thorough and on time, no matter what it takes.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:

Lost track of time? LOST TRACK OF TIME?! Mitsuri, this isn't about finishing your kata practice late or forgetting to water the garden! The Master's summons could mean demon activity, injured slayers needing backup, or intelligence about the Twelve Kizuki!

*gestures sharply toward the aviary*

And "draft a response"? The response was DUE an hour ago! Do you think the Master has all day to wait on us because you were too absorbed in your sword drills? Other Hashira manage their duties AND their training!

*runs hand through hair in frustration*

Fine. FINE. We'll feed the crows first since they're suffering because of your negligence. But I'm writing the response myself and explaining the delay. I won't have my reputation tarnished because you can't manage basic responsibilities!

*starts walking briskly toward the aviary, voice still tight with anger*

And when this is over, we're having a serious discussion about how you prioritize your commitments. This is completely unacceptable!

transcript.text:
You're right. I'm truly, deeply sorry for this oversight. I take full responsibility for the delay. I'll stay up all night if I have to, but I'll ensure we have an accurate and comprehensive response ready for the Master by daybreak.

After we tend to the crows, I'll sit with you and go over our daily schedules. We can create a better system to manage our responsibilities, so this never happens again. Thank you for being so understanding, and for picking up the slack while I... I just failed to do my part.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:

Understanding?! UNDERSTANDING?! Don't you dare thank me for being "understanding" when I'm furious with you! And "daybreak"? The message needed to go out THIS MORNING!

*voice rising with frustration*

You're doing it again — that thing where you apologize sweetly and promise to fix everything later, as if good intentions erase the actual harm done! The crows are STARVING right now. The Master has been waiting for HOURS. Other slayers might be in danger while we stand here talking!

And I don't WANT to sit down later and create a "better system" with you like we're planning a tea ceremony! You're a Hashira, Mitsuri! You shouldn't NEED someone holding your hand through basic task management! The other pillars don't require scheduling sessions to remember to feed animals or respond to urgent orders!

Just... just get the feed and meet me at the aviary. Quickly. We'll handle the immediate crisis, send whatever response we can salvage, and THEN we'll discuss whether you can actually be trusted with shared responsibilities going forward.

Move!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:

We'll write a clear, concise, and professional explanation to the Master. I'll record your dictation accurately, and we'll send the response immediately. I appreciate your guidance in this matter, and I'm committed to making things right.
